after.textHead: 🏠 O'CENTRA GAMES Shop Social Games DAILY REWARD 25 50 100 0 75 125 250 25 500 150 200 50 SIGN IN TO SPIN CLAIM DAILY REWARD SIGN IN TO SPIN 3 FEATURED 3 RECOMMENDED BRISCOLA BRISCOLA Italia Gioca Briscola is Italy's most beloved card game, a point-trick game played with the distinctive 40-card Italian deck (suits: coins, cups, batons, swords). Each playerholds 3 cards and draws after each trick. The trump suit is revealed by the last card dealt, which stays visible until taken. The unusual ranking system (Ace > 3> King > Queen > Jack > 7-2 in point order) makes Briscola distinct from virtually every other card game in the world.
